info.title: hwflow platform
info.description: Multi-tenant API of the hwflow platform: projects, design versions, runs, artifacts, events.

post.description:
Start a sign-up. Always 202 with the same body, whether or not the e-mail is registered: a new
address gets a verification token by e-mail (POST /auth/verify creates the account), a registered
one gets a notice. Dev: HWPLATFORM_DEV_AUTO_VERIFY=true creates the account at once.
Complete a sign-up with the e-mailed token; creates user, tenant and owner membership.
Rotate: the presented refresh token is spent; reusing it later revokes the whole session.

post.summary: Open a session in another of the user's tenants
post.description:
Rotate like /auth/refresh, but the new tokens are for `tenant_id` (the user must be a member), so the
UI needs no password. The presented refresh token is spent; the new one starts a session in that tenant.
Join the tenant of an invitation. The caller must be logged in as the invited e-mail address.

schema.title: Response List Members Api V1 Tenant Members Get

post.description:
Invite an e-mail address to the current tenant. Always 202 with the same body, whether or not the
address has an account or is a member already; the invitation token is sent by e-mail and accepted
with POST /auth/accept-invite by the person who owns the address.

schema.title: Response List Projects Api V1 Projects Get

put.description:
Validate the credential with its adapter, then store it encrypted (replaces the current one; one active
credential per tenant and provider). A subscription token from a tenant that is not an operator tenant is
refused (403). Design runs waiting for a valid key are signalled `retry`.

post.description: Multipart: `design` (design.yaml), `requirements` (requirements.yaml), `notes` (any number of files, stored as notes/<name>), `bundle` (tar.gz of the project files; explicit parts override its entries). Returns 201 for a new version and 200 with the existing one when the content is already stored.

200.description: A version with this content exists

get.summary: A design version with its file list
Download one file of a design version
get.description: 302 to a presigned URL (the bytes when the API has no public S3 URL).

post.description: Starts a build (or design) run for a design version. Admission checks the tenant's `max_concurrent_runs` (429 `quota_exceeded`). Starting the same build again while it is active returns the active run with 200; so does repeating an `Idempotency-Key`.

200.description: An identical run is already active, or the Idempotency-Key was used

get.summary: List runs of a project, newest first
A run with its stages and verdict

post.description: Asks the workflow to cancel. A queued run (no workflow has started it) turns `cancelled` at once; a running one turns `cancelled` when the workflow has stopped its work.

get.summary: manifest.json of the run (rendered from the rows, live while it runs)

schema.title: Response List Artifacts Api V1 Runs  Run Id  Artifacts Get

get.summary: Download an artifact of a run
get.description: 302 to a presigned URL (TTL 300 s); the bytes when the API has no public S3 URL.

get.summary: Questions of a run (open and answered)

schema.title: Response List Questions Api V1 Runs  Run Id  Questions Get

post.description: Writes the answer, then signals `answer_question` to the run's workflow. 409 when the question is not open (already answered, expired, cancelled) or its run has ended; 422 for an answer to an unknown question id or a missing answer for a question without a default.

get.description: Replays the run's events from the outbox after `Last-Event-ID` (or `?last_event_id=`), then follows live events from NATS JetStream. `id:` is the per-run `seq`, `event:` the type, `data:` the CloudEvents envelope. A comment line every 15 s keeps the connection open; the stream ends after run.completed, run.failed or run.cancelled.

get.summary: Events of one project's runs and design versions (SSE)
get.description: `id:` is the outbox id. Without Last-Event-ID the stream starts at the current end.

get.summary: Every event of the caller's tenant (SSE)
get.description: For notifications. `id:` is the outbox id. Without Last-Event-ID the stream starts at the current end.

RunIn.title: RunIn
RunIn.description:
`options` for kind build: until, mc, reuse, force, rebuild, auto, attempts, retry_layout, seeds, iters,
passes, brief (a bool). For kind design: brief (text, required), answerer ("human"), stages.
